U.note: Clear pelican with pouch, pedalling legs and scrolling scenery plus pause, speed and honk, though the honk has little visible effect and the pose is a bit stiff.

V.note: Large, charming pelican in a helmet with a wing on the handlebar, smooth pedalling, reverse, distance and honk counters and a HONK text on click.

W.note: Most polished: expressive pelican, detailed chain, wheel and rack, gentle eased start and stop, audio bell, reduced-motion handling and 44px controls; the cargo bike is an embellishment.

X.note: Works, but the straight vertical legs look awkward, the cloud collides with the sun and the bird is simplistic.

Y.note: Clean outlined pelican with a swinging pouch and good pedalling, but the bird is small and the controls are minimal.

Z.note: Detailed large bicycle with toothed chainring and a hidden click-to-honk, but the pelican reads less clearly, the road moves slowly and the honk has little feedback.
